novel_features.name: Conversation view
novel_features.description: See the delivery timeline with one guest or vendor number: direction, status, parts and cost (Telnyx records carry no message bodies).
novel_features.rationale: Groups synced message detail records by counterpart locally; no single API call does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check when you last texted someone and whether it was delivered before sending anything new.

novel_features.name: Number audit
novel_features.description: Find owned numbers that cannot text: missing messaging profile or missing 10DLC campaign assignment.
novel_features.rationale: Joins phone numbers, messaging profiles, and 10DLC assignments that live in separate API families.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run before blaming carriers for silent send failures.

novel_features.name: Spend rollup
novel_features.description: Total messaging cost by number, profile, direction, or day, with balance runway.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answer what texting cost this month without the portal.

novel_features.name: Failure report
novel_features.description: Failed and undelivered texts grouped by error code and recipient.
novel_features.rationale: Groups synced detail records by error code locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find guests who never got their message.

novel_features.name: Unanswered threads
novel_features.description: Contacts whose latest text was inbound with no reply yet.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find who is still waiting on a reply.

novel_features.name: Agent-safe send
novel_features.description: Send a text after checking the sender is wired correctly and showing recent history; requires --yes.
novel_features.rationale: Combines the local audit row and conversation history with the live send.
novel_features.example: telnyx-pp-cli text --from +12075550100 --to +12075551234 --message 'Your door code is ready' --dry-run
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents should send through this, not the raw endpoint.

narrative.headline: Telnyx messaging, numbers, and voice endpoints, plus a synced message-history mirror, number setup audits, and spend rollups.
narrative.value_prop: Sync your Telnyx messaging detail records into a local database, then see any number's delivery timeline with conversation, who is waiting with inbox unanswered, and costs with spend. numbers audit catches numbers missing a messaging profile or 10DLC campaign assignment before texts fail silently.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set TELNYX_API_KEY to a Telnyx v2 API key (starts with KEY); TELNYX_API_TOKEN is accepted as an alias. Or run `telnyx-pp-cli auth set-token`, and check with `telnyx-pp-cli auth status`.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is installed and config resolves
Pull numbers, profiles, and recent history into the local store
Check every number can actually text
See who is waiting on a reply

troubleshoots.fix: export TELNYX_API_KEY=<your v2 key> (keys start with KEY)

troubleshoots.symptom: Texts to US numbers fail with carrier errors
troubleshoots.fix: telnyx-pp-cli numbers audit to find numbers without an approved 10DLC campaign

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Telnyx SMS/MMS operations from owned numbers: reading conversation history, auditing number setup, tracking spend and failures, and sending texts safely from an agent.
anti_triggers: Building real-time call flows (use webhooks and the Telnyx SDK)
Managing Telnyx AI assistants, storage, or IoT SIMs (out of scope)
